text:
emily (security): Auditor follow-up landed: they want KMS key delegation details, evidence of rotation, and proof of KMS access logs for the last 12 months. Also asked for RBAC change process artifacts for granting key usage to service accounts.

raj (infra): can you paste the auditor excerpt here?

emily (security): pasted: 'Please provide KMS key policy showing delegated admins, rotation schedule and evidence of key usage logs for the past 12 months. Additionally, provide the RBAC change workflow and approvals for any service accounts that have kms:Decrypt or kms:Encrypt rights.'

raj (infra): ok. quick summary from infra: CMKs in aws account: alias/redwood-prod-kms and alias/redwood-ingest-kms. Key policy currently allows roles: arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/redwood-kms-admins, arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/redwood-deploy-bot, and service principal svc-inference-role.

raj (infra): policy snippet (redacted):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/redwood-kms-admins"},
      "Action": "kms:*",
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

emily (security): rotation? where is schedule configured and proof? auditor wants to see "automatic rotation enabled" or manual rotation events.

raj (infra): rotation is enabled for alias/redwood-prod-kms (automatic 30 days). We also have rotation events logged in CloudTrail (KMS KeyRotationEnabled/Disable events and KMS:RevokeGrant/CreateGrant/GenerateDataKey operations). Logs are forwarded to log-archive account and indexed. Retention policy: 7 years for CloudTrail logs (S3 -> Glacier). I can export keyUsage events as CSV for the 12-month window.

sowmya (compliance): auditor will map this to SOC 2 CC6.1 and ISO A.8.3.1 controls. We need: (1) key policy files, (2) screenshot of rotation toggle / config, (3) CloudTrail export filtered for KMS DataEvents showing decrypt/generateDataKey ops, (4) RBAC change tickets/PRs showing approvals.

auditor-bot: evidence-uploaded: kms-policy-prod-2026-02-11.json, kms-rotation-screenshot-2026-02-11.png

emily (security): good. Action items: raj -> export CloudTrail KMS DataEvents (12 months) + attach key policy JSON + grep confirming no wildcards in Principals; sowmya -> assemble control mapping doc linking to SOC 2/ISO clauses + collect RBAC PRs; emily -> draft auditor reply & upload compiled evidence. Target: tomorrow 12:00 PST.

raj (infra): starting Athena query now:
```sql
SELECT eventTime,eventName,userIdentity.arn,requestParameters.keyId
FROM "cloudtrail_logs"
WHERE eventSource = 'kms.amazonaws.com'
  AND eventTime BETWEEN '2025-02-01' AND '2026-02-01';
```
sharing results as soon as it's done. If export size > 50MB I'll split by month.

emily (security): quick Q — any service accounts granted kms:Decrypt via terraform module without explicit ticket approval? auditor will want PRs or an exception doc.

raj (infra): scanned infra state: two service principals with kms:Decrypt: inference-svc-prod and metrics-ingest-svc. Both were added via infra PRs: PR#482 (inference) approved by anna and chris; PR#499 (metrics) approved by dana. I'll link the PRs and include the approval comments.

sowmya (compliance): also provide runbook for emergency key rotation and evidence it's tested (date of last drill). I have runbook v2 in Confluence and a drill log from 2025-11-20.

emily (security): auditor follow-up: please confirm that KMS key policy does not include cross-account root principals or use '*' in Principal.

raj (infra): confirmed: policy scan returned no '*' in Principal and no arn:aws:iam::OTHER_ACCOUNT:root entries. I'll include `grep -n "Principal"` output and the sanitized policy.

devops-bot: notice: export job kms-log-export-181953 started by raj at 1819532160.

emily (security): perfect. Closing notes: we'll attach (1) sanitized key policy jsons, (2) CloudTrail KMS DataEvent exports split by month, (3) screenshots of rotation config, (4) RBAC PR links & approval comments, (5) runbook + drill evidence, (6) control mapping spreadsheet mapping artifacts to SOC 2 and ISO clauses. I'll send draft reply to auditor for review before upload. :thumbsup: 

raj (infra): on it — ETA EOD PST for first exports.

sowmya (compliance): assembling mapping doc now, will ping when ready.

emily (security): thanks team. If the auditor nudges for chain-of-custody for logs, we should include the S3 Object-level inventory + bucket policy that restricts access to log-archive role.

raj (infra): noted, adding bucket policy export to the artifacts list.

emily (security): great. target still tomorrow 12:00 PST.
